family_summary: AI-built pages mostly use restrained decoration (thin borders, small rounded corners, few or no gradients/effects) and replace the originals' photo heroes and square, shadowed styling with flat or gradient backgrounds, with only one site reproducing the original's textured header.

attributes.summary: AI-built pages typically use few or no effects (three of four sites have none, no gradients or only a few transitions, with one using gradients, blur and transitions, and one using header-only backdrop blur), whereas originals more often combine shadows, gradients and many transitions or animations.
AI-built cards consistently use thin borders without shadows (both sites), with one adding category-coded colored left borders, while the originals use soft shadows.
Most AI-built pages (3 of 4) use small rounded corners and one uses pills and large radii, whereas all four originals are mostly square.

value_map.carbon texture with red and blue wedges: carbon texture with red and blue wedges

attributes.summary: The single AI-built page matches the original's carbon texture header with red and blue wedges.
AI-built heroes use flat or gradient color fields with no text over images, whereas both originals use photos, including white headlines on darkened photos.
The AI-built pages that record these use underlined body links and thin padded hairline dividers, with no original values recorded for comparison.
